summary: Petition to the Central Elections Committee concerning the Aug. 30 Damon women's-prison campaign video remains unresolved on the merits.
notes: Freshness recheck through Sep. 5 found no final CEC merits ruling on this specific Damon video. Earlier rulings on different Ben-Gvir campaign videos remain non-transferable; preserve the petition allegations as allegations and do not infer a violation.

summary: Raot Rosenberg's promotion was approved after a prolonged delay and administrative petition, but no merits judgment establishing unlawfulness of the prior delay has been recovered.
notes: Freshness recheck confirmed eventual approval reporting but no merits ruling establishing that the delay itself was unlawful. Preserve Ben-Gvir's defense and do not treat approval after litigation as proof of misconduct.
